notes.title: Bug Fixes and Minor Improvements
notes.content:
This patch includes several fixes and adjustments to improve overall gameplay stability:

[list]
[*] Fixed traps not activating correctly.
[*] Resolved an issue where enemies could fall through the ground.
[*] Equipment now unlocks properly after completing levels.
[*] Automatic skills are correctly triggered at the start of each wave.
[*] Adjusted collision on various meshes.
[*] Improved enemy spawn points to prevent placement issues.
[*] Minor UI improvements.
[/list]

We’re continuing to monitor feedback and will keep refining the experience in upcoming updates.

notes.title: Small Update – Big Impact!
notes.content:
This is one of those “small” updates that actually changes a lot. Here’s what’s new:

🔥 All characters now have Ultimate Skills! Unleash them when your gauge is full and turn the tide of battle.

🛡️ The skill system has been reworked: each class now uses 2 manual skills and 2 auto-target skills, giving you more control without losing the chaos.

⚖️ The game’s difficulty has been rebalanced — still challenging, but no longer punishing from the very start.

🖼️ Small UI improvements for a cleaner and more intuitive experience.

Thanks to everyone who shared feedback — keep it coming, it really helps us shape the game!

notes.title: Demo Update: Mage Class Unlocked & New Map Available!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Keepers![/b]
A brand new update is now live for the Crystal Keepers demo! You can now play as the Mage—unleash magical powers and experiment with new skills. Plus, explore a brand-new map featuring a fresh layout and new challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512620/3ce49bc0f9ef723819eda790be555cea32b0f9a6.gif[/img]

[b]What’s new in this update:[/b]
New Playable Class:

Mage: Master powerful spells and discover unique synergies.

[b]New Map:[/b]

Explore a new battlefield with a different environment and tactical opportunities.

[b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b]

Based on community feedback, the experience is even better!

If you’ve already tried the demo, now is the perfect time to jump back in! If you’re new, dive in and let us know what you think—your feedback helps us shape the future of Crystal Keepers.

Enjoy the new content and stay tuned for more updates!
